manual.turrets.line2: Turrets are the next step is automated defense of your factory. They feature a complex optical system combined with an electronic "brain" to effectively distinguish and acquire targets and use the inbuilt weaponry to neutralize them.
manual.turrets.line3: All turrets feature energy ports at their base, and require a redstone signal to be active, although this behavior can be inverted by sneaking and rightclicking it with an Engineer's Screwdriver.{0}
manual.turrets.line4: Upon being placed, Turrets will remember their owner and will not allow other users to break or modify them. Rightclicking the turret brings up the GUI which features a list of names with an entry field, as well as multiple targeting options.
manual.turrets.line5: By the default the list is a blacklist of targets that may not be attacked. This list utilizes creature names, so whitelisting animals is possible.{0}
manual.turrets.line6: {0}The Chemthrower Turret utilizes the fluid propelling capabilities of the {1}eponymous tool{2} to cover targets in anything, ranging from water to douse flames, to diesel oil to start them.{3}
manual.turrets.line7: This Turret features a fluid port in the bottom and back of the base to allow pipes to connect to it. Additionally, the GUI has a button on the left which dis- or enables the pilot flame, igniting the dispensed fluid, provided that it is flammable.
manual.turrets.line9: §oThe providers of this blueprint are not liable for any damage to user, neighbours or various farm animals that may incur.§r{0}
manual.turrets.line10: {0}The Gun Turret features a heavily modified version of the {1}Revolver's{2} internals in a far bigger and more imposing casing. The construction also involves an extended magazine to allow for increased internal storage of ammunition.{3}
manual.turrets.line11: A port for the automatic insertion of ammo and extraction of spent casing is located within the back and bottom of the base. This Turret can store up to a full stack of cartridges and the GUI features a button to toggle the automatic expulsion of spent casings.
manual.turrets.line13: §oNote that certain ammunitions may cause collateral damage to the user or their property.§r
